name: VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide) (VP) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the VP certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 37221-79-7, formula C147H237N43O43S, 3326.8 Da).

faq.question: How should VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the VP lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide)?
faq.answer: VIP (Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide) is stocked in 2 pack sizes (5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $82.18; 10–49 kits falls to $75.60 (−8%) and 50+ to $69.86 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
